transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net digital TV technical support. My name is Rachel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Rachel. My name is Callum MacLeod. I am having a very irritating problem with the S-Net TV Go application on my tablet while travelling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning Callum. I can certainly help you get your TV Go app streaming properly again. Before we access your subscription, could you confirm your postal address and your account security PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, of course. My address is 59 Bruntsfield Place, Edinburgh, EH10 4HQ, and my security PIN is 8201.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Callum, that passes security. What specific error message or code is displaying when you attempt to stream a channel?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Every time I tap on any live channel or on-demand programme, a black modal pop-up appears stating 'Error 409: Maximum Registered Devices Reached. Please remove an active device in Account Settings to continue.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What device model and operating system are you currently attempting to stream from, Callum?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am using an iPad Air 5th generation running iPadOS 17. The app itself is updated to the latest version from the App Store.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you logged into the S-Net online portal to check how many active devices are registered under your TV Go license?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I tried checking on my mobile phone, but the device management page just throws a spinning loading wheel and says 'Temporarily Unavailable.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. The web portal device manager has scheduled maintenance today, which is why self-service deregistration is failing on your phone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, so I am completely locked out from managing it myself.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have all the details correctly, Callum, your TV Go app on your iPad Air is throwing Error 409 because your account has hit the maximum limit of five registered streaming devices, and because the customer portal is down for maintenance, you need us to wipe the stale devices from our system, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly right, Rachel. That captures the entire problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I open your digital TV provisioning profile on our media gateway terminal and inspect your active device tokens.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Certainly, I will stay on the line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Callum. I have pulled up your device registry. Your account allows five concurrent registered devices under our TV Go licensing agreement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What devices are currently listed as occupying those five slots?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You have an iPhone 11 registered in 2021, a Samsung Galaxy tablet from 2022, an old Windows laptop that hasn't logged in for eighteen months, an Apple TV in your living room, and an older iPad Mini.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good grief! Three of those devices were recycled or sold over a year ago!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Whenever an app is deleted without explicitly signing out, the DRM security token remains registered on our server until manually purged.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am trying to watch the live Champions League European match right now on my iPad while staying in a hotel! The match has already kicked off and I am missing the first half! It is driving me up the wall missing the football over phantom ghost devices from three years ago!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how frustrating it is to miss kickoff when you are looking forward to watching your team in the Champions League, Callum. Please rest assured, I can perform a global device registry purge right now that clears all stale device tokens within sixty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Rachel, that is music to my ears. Please go ahead and purge them.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I execute the global purge on the media gateway, was that the iPad Air 5th generation you want to keep as your registered primary streaming device?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly, the iPad Air 5th generation that I am holding right here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will execute a selective deregistration that preserves your living room Apple TV token while wiping the old iPhone 11, the Samsung tablet, the old laptop, and the iPad Mini.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is ideal so my wife at home doesn't lose access on the main television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Give me a moment while the media rights management database processes the token revocation command.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, waiting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Callum. The four obsolete device licenses have been completely purged from your account profile. You now have four available slots remaining.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to force-close the S-Net TV Go app on my iPad before trying again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please swipe up from the bottom of your iPad screen to close the app from the multitasking switcher, wait five seconds, and relaunch it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, swiping up to close... waiting five seconds... and tapping the S-Net TV Go app icon now. It is loading the channel guide.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please tap on the live sports channel broadcasting the match to initialize the fresh DRM token authorization.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping the TNT Sports 1 stream now... The spinning buffer circle is turning... Yes! The live football match stream has just started playing in high definition! Crystal clear picture and audio!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is fantastic news, Callum! I can see your iPad Air has successfully registered as device slot number two on your profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And it hasn't kicked off the first half score yet, it is still nil-nil! You have genuinely saved my evening, Rachel!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so pleased we could get you back into the match so quickly! You still have three spare device registration slots available for future use.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will make sure to properly sign out of any old devices in the future to keep those slots tidy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once our online portal maintenance concludes later this evening, you will also be able to view and manage registered devices directly from your web browser.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very helpful to know. The streaming quality on hotel Wi-Fi is performing remarkably well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our TV Go player automatically adapts bitrate to match available bandwidth so you won't suffer buffering during live sports playback.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, not a single stutter so far. Everything is operating perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have cleared your stale DRM licenses, registered your iPad Air, and verified seamless live HD playback.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is completely resolved and sorted. I am ready to sit back and watch the game.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else on your S-Net digital TV subscription or home broadband package that I can help with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No thank you Rachel, that was the only problem and it's fixed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net digital TV technical support, Callum. I hope your team gets a great result tonight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much, Rachel! Have a lovely evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too, Callum. Take care and enjoy the football.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are always here 24/7 if you ever need technical assistance with digital streaming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a wonderful rest of your trip in Edinburgh, Callum.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you kindly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please remember that whenever you sell or upgrade an old device in the future, you can sign out of TV Go in the app menu to free up the license slot immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I will definitely make sure to do that from now on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our technical support desk is open 24/7 if you ever encounter any error codes while traveling abroad in Europe.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does TV Go also work while traveling in European countries?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, UK subscribers can stream their TV Go packages in EU destinations for up to thirty days per trip without extra charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is brilliant news, we are holidaying in Spain next month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will have full access to your live channels and recordings there as well, Callum.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wonderful. Thank you so much Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a wonderful rest of your evening and enjoy the football match.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Rachel, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Callum. Goodbye.
